description: This source file contains unit tests for the ChatTheme component within the OpenClawChatUI module. It specifically tests the resolved assistant bubble color appearance on macOS platforms, with a fallback expectation for other platforms.

classes.name: ChatThemeTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for testing ChatTheme related functionalities, specifically appearance resolution for assistant bubble colors.
